dateAssessment: Working calendar: DR 1749 from session YAML; June 29 noon and July 4 morning are spoken at u0016–u0021 and realized by the preparation/flight montage. The roughly 2½-day allocations are approximate; the precise departure day and its afternoon/evening watch remain open. July 4 continues through the nighttime return to Vindristjarna. watches.summary: After the Magistros audience, the DM explicitly places current play at noon on June 29.
About two and a half days of research and preparation follow the June 29 noon opening.
The same sailing is called evening tide, then afternoon; its departure watch remains unresolved.
Arrival is called morning; the additional three-hour flight before eight suggests an initial dawn arrival.
Another three-hour flight precedes the explicit eight-in-the-morning departure from the parked ship.
The ten-mile walk takes two and a half to three hours, ending around noon or shortly after.
Another couple of hours lead to the three-or-four-o’clock approach; the short rest overlaps that wait.
The ogre returns after forty to fifty minutes; a separate hour passes after its message-bearing departure.
Several additional hours pass behind the warehouse; sunset is then about an hour away.
The giant sings half an hour after sunset; conversation continues to the explicitly nighttime return teleport.
